integrity: The exact bounded factor language is certified by substitution-level stabilization with an induction argument and independently cross-checked from the odd-part definition. Every factorization of every factor through the published global cutoff is enumerated exactly, and the full catalogue is embedded.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the regular paperfolding word only. It uses the published global theorem that no paperfolding factor admitting a repetition factorization has length above 45; it does not classify arbitrary paperfolding instruction sequences.
title: Complete repetition-factorization ambiguity profile of the regular paperfolding word
